verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a framework whose AutoGen Studio can set up endpoints from team configurations, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair ask. However, no evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec being published. The JSON team specifications and component serialization describe agent configurations, not an API contract. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, but those paths were at the microsoft.github.io root rather than AutoGen-specific locations, so that check is weak.
